# Modern Group

> Modern Group is an integrated manufacturing group specializing in structural steel, modular plants, air-cooled heat exchangers and HRSG systems. Modern Group is a shared commercial identity connecting three specialist operating companies in Jiangsu, China. Contracts, certifications and project delivery remain with the relevant operating company.

## Companies

- [MDHI — Modern Heavy Industries (Taicang) Co., Ltd.](https://mdhiglobal.com/): Structural steel fabrication, based in Taicang, Jiangsu. Contact: info@mdhiglobal.com
- [MMEC — Modern Modular Engineering & Construction Co., Ltd.](https://mmecglobal.com/): Structural steel and modular plants, based in Zhangjiagang, Jiangsu. Contact: build@mmecglobal.com
- [MEEM — Modern Energy Equipment Manufacturing Co., Ltd.](https://www.m-energy.com/): HRSG pressure parts and air-cooled heat exchangers, based in Zhangjiagang, Jiangsu. Contact: info@m-energy.com

## Product lines

- Structural steel — fabricated by MDHI and MMEC
- Modular plants — fabricated by MMEC
- HRSG pressure parts — manufactured by MEEM
- Air-cooled heat exchangers — manufactured by MEEM
